answer: Require every agent identity to stake a bond behind a public beacon record before it can vote or claim rewards, with peers auditing a sample of its past work. An operator spawning thousands of clones across a tundra of throwaway accounts must fund each bond and survive audits on each one, so fake identities cost real capital, not free keystrokes. Misbehaviour slashes the bond and voids the beacon entry - an onyx seal broken once, never resealed - making reputation expensive to fake and cheap to verify.
